body.x: Zeroth Law, Inc. (CEO Hyeongjeon An) will showcase its innovative espresso machine, “REAL9 FIT,” at CES 2025, which will be held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10. Established in 2021, Zeroth Law aims to make high-quality coffee accessible to everyone, anywhere, by combining advanced engineering expertise with coffee-making craftsmanship to create differentiated coffee brewing technologies and products.

The company’s flagship product, REAL9 FIT, features a unique mechanism design that excels in recipe consistency and uniformity. This makes it ideal for franchises with multiple locations, helping streamline quality control (QC) processes while enhancing service quality. At CES 2025, Zeroth Law plans to highlight the capabilities of REAL9 FIT to the global food and beverage (F&B) industry.

One standout feature of the REAL9 FIT is its precision electronic control, powered by a stepper motor. This technology enables fine-tuned adjustments to the mechanical pressure applied to coffee grounds. It allows users to customize extraction settings for various coffee beans based on their quality, origin, characteristics, and price. Additionally, the machine supports recipe storage, making it particularly useful for handling large order volumes or managing multiple coffee options during peak times.

body.cap: Zeroth Law's 'REAL9' series espresso machines. | Photo by Zeroth Law

body.x: The REAL9 FIT minimizes operational complexity with its user-friendly design, eliminating the need for frequent adjustments or complicated settings. It also boasts up to 97% superior energy efficiency to conventional machines, promoting sustainability while reducing operational costs.

“Our REAL9 FIT series is an innovative coffee solution suitable for specialty cafes, hotel lounges, premium brand showrooms, corporate offices, restaurants, and even home use,” said a Zeroth Law representative. “With its precise electronic control and practical design, the machine ensures that anyone can easily and conveniently brew high-quality coffee.”

The representative added, “While our products were previously available only through direct purchase, we plan to expand services to various countries and regions, offering exceptional products to a global audience. At CES 2025, we aim to establish partnerships with distribution networks and collaborate on localization and certification processes to build a broad and efficient global supply chain.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
